# BMQOS

> BMQOS is an open-source web control panel and operating system for running a company with AI agents.

BMQOS brings autonomous AI agents, human oversight, and organizational workflows into a single unified desktop and web workspace. It features real-time task coordination, an inbox with approval cards for sensitive agent actions, team and service telemetry, audit logging, and an optional native Linux desktop companion.

## Quickstart for Agents

Tell your agent: install github.com/jusbenny0/bmqos

1. Clone: `git clone https://github.com/jusbenny0/bmqos.git && cd bmqos`
2. Install: `npm ci` (Node.js 24)
3. Configure:
   - `cp .env.example .env`
   - Set `OS_SESSION_SECRET` (minimum 32 random characters)
   - Generate password hash: `npm run hash -- 'your-password'` and set `OS_PASSWORD_HASH`
   - Set `OS_USER=admin`
   - Note: Leave integration URLs (`HERMES_API_URL`, `CREW_API_URL`, `PAPERCLIP_API_URL`) unset for zero-dependency Demo Mode.
4. Run:
   - Dev: `npm run dev` (http://localhost:3000)
   - Build & Start: `npm run build && npm start`
   - Docker: `docker compose up -d`
5. Verify:
   - `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit)
   - `npm test` (native test runner in tests/*.test.mts)
   - `curl -i http://localhost:3000/login` (HTTP 200)

## Repository Structure

- `app/`: Next.js App Router pages, layouts, styles (`os.css`, `shell.css`), and REST/SSE API routes (`/api/*`).
- `components/`: UI components for desktop shell, window management, chat, inbox, telemetry charts, and modals.
- `lib/`: Core backend logic: authentication, SQLite database (`db.ts`), agent chat (`hermes.ts`), task orchestration (`crew.ts`), redaction (`redact.ts`), and service monitoring.
- `engine/`: Bundled agent workforce engine (Next.js + SQLite, port 3800): CEO/builder/reviewer/QA agents on the Claude Code CLI, Crew API, MCP server (`engine/mcp/server.mts`), launchers. Own `package.json`; install with `npm run engine:install`, run panel + engine with `npm run start:all`.
- `desktop/`: Native Linux desktop companion app built with Tauri 2 (Rust).
- `scripts/`: CLI utilities including `hash.mjs` (scrypt password hashing).
- `tests/`: End-to-end and unit test suites (*.test.mts).
- `public/`: Static web assets, web push service worker, fonts, and icons.
- `Dockerfile` & `docker-compose.yml`: Multi-stage production container setup with volume persistence.

## Development & Testing Commands

- `npm run dev`: Start local development server on port 3000
- `npm run build`: Compile standalone production Next.js build
- `npm run start`: Start production server
- `npm run typecheck`: Run TypeScript compiler check (`tsc --noEmit`)
- `npm test`: Run test suite (`node --conditions react-server --import tsx --test tests/*.test.mts`)
- `npm run hash -- '<password>'`: Generate scrypt password hash for `.env`

## Agent Guardrails & Conventions

- Do not commit `.env` or any credential files.
- Do not push directly to remote git repositories.
- Do not modify LICENSE.
- Do not execute destructive system commands.
- Keep changes surgical, run `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` before finishing tasks.
